question: Should OpenClaw sponsor the shared localization contract and review this cumulative foundation series in the declared order, or require independently mergeable owner-scoped slices first?
rationale: This feature introduces a new cross-surface product and protocol direction spanning CLI, TUI, Gateway, Control UI, approval safety copy, channel menus, and plugin/skill metadata; the protected maintainer label requires an explicit owner decision.

options.title: Sequence the foundation PRs
options.body: Review and land the prerequisites in the declared order, then refresh this product-surface slice as a focused non-cumulative change.

options.title: Sponsor the cumulative design
options.body: Explicitly accept the combined localization contract and assign owners for the Gateway, UI, channel, and plugin metadata boundaries.

options.title: Require a narrower design
options.body: Ask for separately mergeable ownership slices before accepting the shared package and cross-surface adoption model.

recommendation.title: Sequence the foundation PRs
recommendation.body: Review and land the prerequisites in the declared order, then refresh this product-surface slice as a focused non-cumulative change.

likelyOwner.reason: The provided context identifies this contributor as the author of the proposal and the stated foundation series; direct code-history ownership tracing was unavailable.
